_comment: Parametrized coverage floors for the PR Coverage Gate (LBA-REQ-016 CM / ISO-IEC-IEEE 29119). These are the fail-under thresholds c8 enforces. Ratchet them UP CONSERVATIVELY with `npm run coverage:bump`: each floor rises by at most `step` toward `measured - buffer` (headroom below the measured coverage so normal variance never trips the required gate), capped at `target`; never lower them by hand. Measured at adoption: lines/statements 73%, functions 62%, branches 49%.
